reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, this is the fix proposed in #195, and it is clean: the dev layout now matches the packaged one, `electron-builder.json` copies the whole target directory instead of renaming files one by one, and the old names are gone from the code and docs.

We ran it in the dev app on macOS (with no `rg` on `PATH`): the sidecar starts from `binaries/aarch64-apple-darwin/`, the file search finds files outside a git repo, and Glob and Grep work in a chat. The macOS and Windows packaging jobs pass too.

We pushed a merge of `main` on top to resolve the CHANGELOG conflict. Approving and merging. Thanks again!
